title: Open Public Contracting Tender Integrity and Asset Recovery Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal enforcing 100% public procurement disclosure on an Open Contracting Data Standard portal, 10-year contractor defect liability, criminal asset forfeiture for substandard infrastructure, and an Independent Public Procurement Ombudsman.
notes: Matter 024: Open Public Contracting Tender Integrity and Asset Recovery Bill, 2026.
